question: The curve giving the maximum amount of corn that can be produced in the economy for any given amount of cotton and vice-versa. This curve is called the ____.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Production possibility frontier**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The curve that gives the **maximum amount of corn that can be produced in the economy for any given amount of cotton, **and vice versa, **is called the Production Possibility Frontier (PPF).**
 
• **Production Efficiency:**
 
 
• The PPF represents the different combinations of corn and cotton production that can be achieved with the available resources and technology in the economy.
